page_topic_one_liner: Agentic payments — AP2 authorization mandates, ACP checkout, and x402/MPP settlement rails for programmatic agent-initiated payments within scoped budgets
differentiator_vs_generic: This is the money-movement protocol stack for non-human payers — NOT shopping product discovery (that's agentic-commerce), NOT generic fintech dashboard. Hero must show layered payment flow: mandate → checkout → settlement with HTTP 402 micropayment cue.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Six-layer payment stack diagram stacked vertically — discovery → communication → trust → authorization (AP2 mandate doc icon) → checkout (ACP cart handshake) → settlement (x402 coin/402 badge), klein-blue accent arrows flowing downward through layers
Secondary: HTTP 402 response tile — server returns 402 + price, agent wallet pays USDC, retry arrow with payment header
Tertiary: scoped mandate envelope — signed spend cap document with agent identity seal, no PAN exposure
anti_patterns: Product comparison shopping grid as hero
Generic credit card swipe without mandate/settlement layers
Human 3DS OTP flow as primary visual
Single-protocol logo wall without stack narrative
